ios.desc:
Imagine Storiez is the BEST family friendly, word based party game for your next game night! Each player is challenged to make a short story using 5 random words in under 1 minute, and it's loads of fun seeing each other make wacky stories to try and include all the words before time runs out. 

But the fun doesn't stop there! You can also try:
• Emoji mode: Play with emojis instead of words for an extra challenge! 
• Story Hot Potato: Each player adds a sentence to an ongoing story using the word on the screen before time runs out.

Imagine Storiez is perfect for all ages, safe for work / kids, and loads of fun on the go. Download Imagine Storiez to get lifetime access to all modes without ads and start making unforgettable stories and memories today, we promise you won't regret it!

Still on the fence? Please reach out to us at freestyle.feedback@gmail.com if we can answer any questions!

show_hn.title: Show HN: How I made an iOS party game in just 3 days

quotes.text:
Hey guys, this is my first Hacker News post. Happy to be here :)

I recently created Imagine Storiez, where players are challenged to make a short story using 5 random words in under a minute. The game is safe to play with kids or at work. The important thing is that I made the first version of the game in just 3 days of coding. Here's how:

1) Mindset: Every idea can be condensed down into something that can be shipped in 24-72 hours. Even if it’s an extremely simplified version that doesn't have the features that the final app will, the core idea can almost always be conveyed using something simpler. [1]
2) Quantity: This is my 6th app. As I make more and more apps, I can see myself re-using parts of my code, which helps speed up development time. For example, in Imagine Storiez, I re-used a confetti extension I had found before [2], a press-able button animation I use frequently, and certain UI components I had written out from my previous apps. 
3) Research: Before jumping into coding, I took some time to do design research, and I came across some great articles, one of which I used [3], and some of which I didn’t but could help me in the future [4]. 
4) List of goals: After researching, I always lay out a list of EXACTLY what I am going to do for the first version to avoid getting carried away. Hey guys! I wanted to share my story with you all and ask for some advice.

I took on the challenge this week of getting 100 paid downloads for my iOS app without spending any money on marketing. The app is called Imagine Storiez, and it's a family friendly party game where each player tried to make a short story using 5 random words in under a minute. There is an emoji mode as well, and it is priced at 0.99 USD (Link for reference: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/imagine-storiez/id6497486404 )

Here is what I am doing on my end to promote the app:

Posting in forums / relevant discord communities

Blogging about my progress each day on Medium: https://medium.com/@tech_talk_/best-ios-game-for-whole-family-and-how-i-am-trying-to-get-100-organic-downloads-this-week-a882eb34afe1

Making reels that are entertaining and track my progress through the week. I am posting these on Youtube, Insta, X, and TikTok, and engaging with people when possible. Here is an example reel: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/H5EDtxWcb2w

Creating valuable posts that sometimes mention the app in Reddit.

None of this is working, and I am really worried that I am not going to be able to complete the challenge. But I really want to prove to myself that I can get sales, because I don't think I should be spending more time developing apps if I can't get them to the right audience (I have already made 5 apps before this that did not take off).

quotes.text:
Hello everyone. After making 6 different apps and realizing that none of them are going to attract tons of users on their own, I decided to challenge myself this week to get 100 organic downloads for my paid (1 dollar) iOS game, Imagine Storiez.

The issue is that no matter what I try, I can't seem to get in front of my target audience. I am using every social media, making engaging reels tracking my progress to raise awareness, and blogging as well. But I just can't seem to get in front of the right people.

If anyone has experience successfully getting paid downloads without spending money on ads please advise me on how I can finish the challenge and get 100 downloads by the end of the week..

I have added links to my Medium article and the app down below for reference:

Link to app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/imagine-storiez/id6497486404
Link to article: https://medium.com/@tech_talk_/best-ios-game-for-whole-family-and-how-i-am-trying-to-get-100-organic-downloads-this-week-a882eb34afe1

Thank you!
